title: A coordinate bond: ammonium
caption: Ammonia's lone pair on nitrogen is donated to an H⁺ ion, which has no electrons. Once formed, the coordinate bond is identical to the other three N–H bonds; the ion carries a +1 charge.
alt: Dot-and-cross diagram of the ammonium ion in brackets with a + charge: four shared pairs around nitrogen, one of them two nitrogen electrons.
description: Nitrogen in the centre with four hydrogens.
Three N–H bonds each share a dot (N) and a cross (H).
The fourth bond's pair is two dots, both from nitrogen: the coordinate bond.
